name: Gridmet Meteorology Related Variables
description: Spatial aggregations of gridMET meteorological variables. gridMET is a dataset of daily high-spatial resolution (~4-km, 1/24th degree) surface meteorological data covering the contiguous US from 1979-present. These data are updated daily. gridMET blends spatial attributes of gridded climate data from PRISM with desirable temporal attributes from regional reanalysis (NLDAS-2) using climatically aided interpolation. The spatial aggregations are performed over meteorology related variables from (raster) grid into (GIS vector) polygons.

content.Related publications: Abatzoglou, J.T., 2013. Development of gridded surface meteorological data for ecological applications and modelling. International journal of climatology, 33(1), pp.121-131.  https://doi.org/10.1002/joc.3413

name: Gridmet Meteorology Related Variables
description: County-level daily spatial aggregations of gridMET meteorological variables. gridMET provides high-resolution (~4-km) surface meteorological data including temperature, precipitation, humidity, solar radiation, and wind velocity, updated daily. These data are suitable for ecological, agricultural, and hydrological modeling applications.

content.th: Float64: Wind direction at 10m (°Degrees clockwise from North)

name: Gridmet Meteorology Seasonal Variables
description: County-level seasonal spatial aggregations of gridMET meteorological variables. gridMET provides high-resolution (~4-km) surface meteorological data including temperature, precipitation, humidity, solar radiation, and wind velocity. Summer season spans June 1 through August 31, while winter encompasses January 1 through February 28 (or 29 in leap years) and December 1 through 31 within the same calendar year.

name: Gridmet Meteorology Population-Weighted Variables
description: County-level daily population-weighted spatial aggregations of gridMET meteorological variables. gridMET provides high-resolution (~4-km) surface meteorological data including temperature, precipitation, humidity, solar radiation, and wind velocity, updated daily. Each gridMET variable is aggregated as a population-weighted mean using GPW v4 population count data (doi:10.7910/DVN/C0LVYI), with population layers matched to the nearest available census year (2000, 2005, 2010, 2015, or 2020).

content.sph: Float64: Population-weighted mean near-surface specific humidity (kg/kg)
content.vpd: Float64: Population-weighted mean vapor pressure deficit (kPa)
content.tmmn: Float64: Population-weighted minimum near-surface air temperature (°K)
content.tmmx: Float64: Population-weighted maximum near-surface air temperature (°K)
content.rmin: Float64: Population-weighted minimum near-surface relative humidity (%)
content.rmax: Float64: Population-weighted maximum near-surface relative humidity (%)
content.srad: Float64: Population-weighted surface downwelling solar radiation (W/m^2)
content.th: Float64: Population-weighted wind direction at 10m (°Degrees clockwise from North)
